name: ai-design-skills
one_liner: A drop-in instruction file that teaches AI coding tools how to design and write a professional-looking landing page from scratch, including the copy and visual style.
buyer: A freelance web developer or one-person digital agency who builds landing pages for small local businesses and wants AI output that doesn't look like a template everyone recognizes.
business_use_cases: A freelancer installs it in every new client project so the AI's first landing-page draft is already client-ready instead of needing a full design pass.
A no-code agency uses it to standardize page quality across junior staff who use AI tools but lack formal design training.
A SaaS founder uses it to generate a believable marketing site before they can afford to hire a designer.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'landing page in 48 hours' service to small businesses, using the skill to cut design time dramatically.
Package a customized, branded fork of the skill (with a client's own fonts/colors baked in) as a paid starter kit for agencies.

steal_this: Fork it this weekend, swap in your own color/type system, and offer three 'done in a day' landing pages to local businesses at a fixed price to prove the workflow.
